messages.subject: PyStan 2.10.0.0 available on PyPI
messages.body_plain:
PyStan 2.10.0.0 is now available on PyPI:
https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan

Source is available on PyPI as well as at
https://github.com/stan-dev/pystan/releases/tag/v2.10.0.0

What's New
=======

V2.10.0.0 (18. July 2016)
=========================
- Update Stan source to v2.10.0 (release notes at
https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/releases/tag/v2.10.0)
- Sampling in ``Fixed_param`` mode now works. Thanks to @luac for the
fix and @axch for the original report.
- Detailed installation instructions from @chendaniely added to the
documentation.

AR

messages.subject: CmdStan v2.11.0 released! Please upgrade from v2.10.0.
messages.subject_clean: CmdStan v2.11.0 released! Please upgrade from v2.10.0.
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

CmdStan v2.11.0 was released today: https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan/releases/tag/v2.11.0

There was a bug in sampling introduced in Stan v2.10.0 (stan-dev/stan#1972 <https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1972>) that was fixed for this version. We suggest upgrading from v2.10.0 to v2.11.0 immediately.

For users of Stan.jl, MatlabStan, or StataStan, upgrading the underlying CmdStan installation will be sufficient.

RStan and PyStan will be patched and released soon.

If you have any questions or difficulties with the new version, please let us know on the stan-users list <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/stan-users>.

Daniel
